name: attachments_message
sql: CREATE INDEX attachments_message ON attachments (message_seq)

name: control_sessions_phone
sql: CREATE INDEX control_sessions_phone ON control_sessions (phone_id, started_at)

name: device_events_phone
sql: CREATE INDEX device_events_phone ON device_events (phone_id, id)

name: messages_number
sql: CREATE INDEX messages_number ON messages (number_id, seq)

name: messages_unattributed
sql: CREATE INDEX messages_unattributed ON messages (seq) WHERE number_id IS NULL

name: number_bindings_open_number
sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX number_bindings_open_number ON number_bindings (number_id) WHERE to_at IS NULL

name: number_bindings_open_sim
sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX number_bindings_open_sim ON number_bindings (sim_id) WHERE to_at IS NULL

name: sessions_user
sql: CREATE INDEX sessions_user ON sessions (user_id)

name: sim_placements_open_sim
sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX sim_placements_open_sim ON sim_placements (sim_id) WHERE to_at IS NULL

name: sim_placements_open_slot
sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX sim_placements_open_slot ON sim_placements (phone_id, slot) WHERE to_at IS NULL

name: _migrations
sql: CREATE TABLE _migrations (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, file TEXT NOT NULL, applied_at TEXT NOT NULL)

name: api_keys
sql:
CREATE TABLE api_keys (
	id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
	name TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 64),
	-- read: GET requests only. full: everything a signed-in user can do
	-- except managing keys and passwords.
	scope TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (scope IN ('read', 'full')),
	prefix TEXT NOT NULL,
	key_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (length(key_sha256) = 64),
	created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
	last_used_at TEXT,
	revoked_at TEXT
)

name: attachments
sql:
CREATE TABLE attachments (
	id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
	message_seq INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES messages (seq),
	content_type TEXT NOT NULL,
	size INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (size >= 0),
	sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(sha256) = 64),
	filename TEXT
)

name: control_sessions
sql:
CREATE TABLE control_sessions (
	id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
	phone_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES phones (id),
	login TEXT,
	started_at TEXT NOT NULL,
	ended_at TEXT,
	inputs INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
	texts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
	rejected INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
)

name: device_events
sql:
CREATE TABLE device_events (
	id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
	phone_id INTEGER REFERENCES phones (id),
	at TEXT NOT NULL,
	kind TEXT NOT NULL,
	detail_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'
)

name: health_5m
sql:
CREATE TABLE health_5m (
	phone_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES phones (id),
	-- Start of the bucket, ISO 8601 UTC.
	bucket TEXT NOT NULL,
	samples INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (samples > 0),
	-- Mean battery level and highest temperature (tenths of a degree C).
	battery_pct INTEGER,
	battery_temp_dc INTEGER,
	-- By slot: {"0": {"minLevel": 2, "dbm": -110}}.
	signal_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
	-- By slot: share of samples in service, {"0": 1}.
	service_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
	-- Internet mobile bytes over the trailing 24 h at the last data watch.
	mobile_rx INTEGER,
	mobile_tx INTEGER,
	PRIMARY KEY (phone_id, bucket)
) WITHOUT ROWID

name: ingest_cursors
sql:
CREATE TABLE ingest_cursors (
	phone_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES phones (id),
	provider TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (provider IN ('sms', 'mms')),
	last_provider_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
	PRIMARY KEY (phone_id, provider)
)

name: inventory_edits
sql:
CREATE TABLE inventory_edits (
	id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
	at TEXT NOT NULL,
	login TEXT,
	entity TEXT NOT NULL,
	entity_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
	changes_json TEXT NOT NULL
)

name: messages
sql:
CREATE TABLE messages (
	seq INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
	phone_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES phones (id),
	provider TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (provider IN ('sms', 'mms')),
	-- The provider row's _id. It can repeat if Messages' data is cleared, so
	-- the dedup key includes received_at.
	provider_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
	sub_id INTEGER,
	-- Resolved from (phone, sub_id) through sim_placements, then through
	-- number_bindings; null until the SIM is known, and filled in later.
	sim_id INTEGER REFERENCES sims (id),
	number_id INTEGER REFERENCES numbers (id),
	sender TEXT,
	body TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
	-- MMS only.
	subject TEXT,
	-- Carrier time (date_sent), the phone's clock (date), and the server's clock.
	sent_at TEXT,
	received_at TEXT NOT NULL,
	ingested_at TEXT NOT NULL,
	UNIQUE (phone_id, provider, provider_id, received_at)
)

name: number_bindings
sql:
CREATE TABLE number_bindings (
	id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
	number_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES numbers (id),
	sim_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sims (id),
	from_at TEXT NOT NULL,
	to_at TEXT,
	-- What the SIM reported, normalized, at the last probe.
	detected_e164 TEXT,
	-- Who typed the number, when a person set it.
	confirmed_by TEXT,
	CHECK (to_at IS NULL OR to_at >= from_at)
)

name: numbers
sql:
CREATE TABLE numbers (
	id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
	e164 TEXT UNIQUE CHECK (e164 IS NULL OR e164 GLOB '+[1-9]*'),
	e164_source TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (e164_source IN ('detected', 'manual', 'none')),
	note TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
	created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
	CHECK ((e164 IS NULL) = (e164_source = 'none'))
)

name: phones
sql:
CREATE TABLE phones (
	id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
	serial TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
	site TEXT NOT NULL,
	manufacturer TEXT,
	model TEXT,
	android_version TEXT,
	sdk INTEGER,
	build_fingerprint TEXT,
	imei1 TEXT,
	imei2 TEXT,
	location TEXT,
	hub_port TEXT,
	cost_cents INTEGER CHECK (cost_cents IS NULL OR cost_cents >= 0),
	acquired_on TEXT,
	-- The last adb state seen (device, unauthorized, offline, gone, ...).
	last_state TEXT NOT NULL,
	first_seen_at TEXT NOT NULL,
	-- The last time the phone was online (adb state "device").
	last_online_at TEXT
)

name: sessions
sql:
CREATE TABLE sessions (
	id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
	token_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (length(token_sha256) = 64),
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
	created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
	last_seen_at TEXT NOT NULL,
	expires_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

name: sim_placements
sql:
CREATE TABLE sim_placements (
	id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
	sim_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sims (id),
	phone_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES phones (id),
	slot INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (slot >= 0),
	sub_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
	from_at TEXT NOT NULL,
	to_at TEXT,
	CHECK (to_at IS NULL OR to_at >= from_at)
)

name: sims
sql:
CREATE TABLE sims (
	id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
	iccid TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
	carrier TEXT,
	account_ref TEXT,
	plan TEXT,
	renews_on TEXT,
	cost_cents INTEGER CHECK (cost_cents IS NULL OR cost_cents >= 0),
	status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'spare', 'retired')),
	first_seen_at TEXT NOT NULL,
	last_seen_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

name: sqlite_sequence
sql: CREATE TABLE sqlite_sequence(name,seq)

name: users
sql:
CREATE TABLE users (
	id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
	name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE CHECK (length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 64),
	-- argon2id, in the PHC string format Bun.password writes.
	password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
	created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
	password_changed_at TEXT NOT NULL
)
